lineas.gancho: What if the Tamagotchi… were you?
lineas.casa: MPH is a 3D house where every room is an app: kitchen, workouts, finances, goals, music…
lineas.disena: Design your house and choose which app goes in each room: your hub for entertainment, study, creativity and self-care.
lineas.metas: Your agenda, your calendar, your journal and a personal assistant to hit your goals in real life.
lineas.ia: Talk to your assistants like you would with ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude: they log your day and create images, resources and 3D models.
lineas.cerebro: Social media fragments your attention and technology thinks for you. MPH is the most complete and fun way to use your brain and watch the habits you choose grow.
lineas.idiomas: In 16 languages. Web, desktop and mobile. With AI credits, with free local models… or with no AI at all.
lineas.cta: Try it for free. Or make it yours with a single payment.
lineas.eslogan: Build your character by building your habits. Design your house, designing your future.

titulares.gancho: What if you were a Tamagotchi?

cierre: Build your character, building your habits.
Design your house, designing your future.
Conquer the goals of each room, conquering your to-dos.
